title: migrate: past continuity proof needs an unbroken key chain
description: Mark 2026-10-23 chose (a): a continuity proof does not survive a change only registry review let through (lost-key recovery, re-registration). git-vouch-migrate _prove (vouch-omzm.9, commit 768785d) accepts a proof made for an earlier committed version of people/<h>.json without checking the versions after it. Require: every later committed version is signed by a key listed in the version before it (the same rule git vouch check warns on). A gap means the old proof does not count; the holder makes a fresh .asc. Re-registration after deletion is a gap.
acceptance_criteria: Hand-written tests: proof for v1, v2 signed by v1's key -> counts; v2 replacing all keys signed only by its own new key (recovery) -> does not count, error tells the holder to make a fresh .asc; delete then re-register -> does not count. Tests pass on 3.12 and 3.9; ruff clean; flag-day.md states the rule.
